title: seo-content-brief template variables
description: Values for templates/seo-content-brief.md.j2 and templates/seo-content-brief.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from seo-content-brief.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

current_position.title: Current position
current_position.description: Where you rank today, or "not ranking". It decides whether this is a rewrite or a new page - and a page at position 12 is usually worth more attention than a new one.

element_1.title: Element 1
element_1.description: The element 1 used under 'Common Elements (all top 3 include)'.

element_2.title: Element 2
element_2.description: The element 2 used under 'Common Elements (all top 3 include)'.

existing_pages.title: Existing pages
existing_pages.description: Link TO these pages from this article. From section 'Internal Links'.

keyword_difficulty.title: Keyword difficulty
keyword_difficulty.description: Difficulty score 1-100 from the same tool as the volume. If it is above your site's realistic ceiling, say so here rather than discovering it four months after publishing.

list.title: List
list.description: Words - Key sections. From section 'Top 3 Results'.

opportunity_1.title: Opportunity 1
opportunity_1.description: The opportunity 1 used under 'Missing From All (opportunity)'.

search_intent.title: Search intent
search_intent.description: What the searcher actually wants, read off the current SERP rather than guessed. Writing a guide against a transactional SERP is the single most common reason good content never ranks.

search_volume.title: Search volume
search_volume.description: Monthly search volume with the tool and country it came from. Tools disagree by multiples, so the source is half the number - without it nobody can sanity-check the effort estimate.

target_keyword.title: Target keyword
target_keyword.description: The exact query you are writing for, as a searcher types it. One per brief - a page targeting three keywords ranks for none of them and reads like it was written for a machine.

target_word_count.title: Target word count
target_word_count.description: Target length as a range, derived from the top three results and not from a house style. If the SERP winners are 800 words, a 3,000-word piece is padding that dilutes the thing being ranked.

url_slug.title: Url slug
url_slug.description: The URL slug, lowercase and hyphenated. Decide it now - changing it after publication costs a redirect and some of the authority the page earned.

word_count.title: Word count
word_count.description: The word count used under 'Top 3 Results'.
